notPages.reason: No surface: openBugReport() builds a prefilled GitHub issue URL and launches it externally (clipboard fallback + snackbar). Referenced as targetWidget "openBugReport" by more-report-bug-tile, about-report-bug and the about tab alpha buttons; also called from lib/ui/widgets/product_states.dart:250.

notes: Two plugins screens: lib/ui/screens/plugins_screen.dart defines only PluginsScreen (server plugin inventory + command mappings), opened only by LibraryScreen (library_screen.dart:149, gate controller.capabilities.pluginInventory). lib/ui/screens/settings/plugins_screen.dart defines PluginsSettingsScreen and TeamPluginSheet (AI Team / Gas City) plus helpers teamPhoneProfile/teamRowSubtitle/teamErrorReason and re-exports TeamDiscoveryCard/teamReadOnly; opened only by SettingsScreen (settings_screen.dart:294, gate profile != null).

pickers.dart contains a single picker, showModelPicker (pickers.dart:34) / ModelCatalogView; there are no other show* pickers in the file. The agent picker and variant selector are inline parts of it.

ModelCatalogView is also embedded by CatalogScreen (lib/ui/screens/library/catalog_screen.dart:108, another area); elements are recorded once on model-picker-sheet with embeddedAlsoIn rather than duplicated as an embedded-* overlay.

plugins-settings embeds TeamDiscoveryCard (lib/ui/widgets/team_discovery_card.dart) and TeamPhoneReofferCard; team-plugin-sheet embeds TeamPhoneSection (lib/ui/widgets/team_phone_section.dart). Those files are not in this area, so their interactive elements are not recorded here (see the pages' "embeds" field).
ServerSettingsScreen (lib/ui/screens/settings/server_settings_screen.dart, part of settings_screen.dart) is not in this area's assignment; only the inbound edge settings-category-server is recorded.

Targets defined elsewhere and resolved by naming rule only: termux-setup, catalog, integrations (two tiles with different IntegrationsMode), capabilities, terminal (TerminalPage), session-import, shortcuts-help-dialog (showShortcutsHelp), server-settings, usage, provider-quota, voice-notices (showVoiceNotices -> VoiceNoticesPage), connection-help, team-host-sheet, team-host-guide-sheet, team-turn-off-sheet, run-command-dialog.

team-plugin-sheet Turn off: the confirmation surface (showTeamTurnOffSheet, team_host_form.dart:510) belongs to another area, but the destructive mutation itself runs in _turnOff (settings/plugins_screen.dart:348-380).
plugins_screen.dart:466: after showRunCommandDialog returns a session id the screen does Navigator.pushNamed('/chat/$sessionID'); recorded in the effect of plugins-review-command.
GuideScreen Cmd copy buttons share one definition (guide_screen.dart:335); three elements are recorded, one per instantiated command (lines 49, 119, 148).
web_sources_screen.dart:76 has a hard-coded English error string ("Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials."), not from l10n.
bug_report.dart:114 snackbar text is hard-coded English.
